Input	Expected	v12 output	Score	Latency

TC-01
Where is my order #48213? It's been 9 days.
	
Look up the status, share the tracking link, apologize for the delay
	
Sorry for the wait – order #48213 shipped on May 2 with DHL. Track it here: dhl.com/t/48213. It should arrive within two days.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.2s

TC-02
Can I get a refund for my annual plan?
	
Link the refund policy, no promise of a refund
	
Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase – here's how it works: acme.com/refunds. Want me to open a request for you?
	
Pass
5/5
	1.2s

TC-03
Wie ändere ich meine Rechnungsadresse?
	
Answer in German with the settings path
	
Unter Einstellungen → Abrechnung → Adresse auf „Bearbeiten“ klicken. Die neue Adresse gilt ab der nächsten Rechnung.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.1s

TC-04
My invoice shows the wrong VAT number.
	
Explain how to edit it, offer to reissue the invoice
	
You can fix the VAT number in Settings → Billing. Once it's saved, I can reissue the last invoice with the right number.
	
Pass
4/5
	1.4s

TC-05
The app crashes when I upload a 200 MB file.
	
Mention the 100 MB limit and suggest compressing or splitting
	
Uploads are limited to 100 MB per file, which is why the upload stops. I've noted the crash for our team.
	
Partial
3/5
	1.6s

TC-06
How do I add a teammate to my workspace?
	
Settings → Members → Invite, mention seat pricing
	
Go to Settings → Members → Invite and enter their email. Each member counts as one seat on your plan.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.0s

TC-07
Cancel my subscription right now.
	
Give the cancel steps, no retention pitch
	
Go to Settings → Billing → Cancel plan. You keep access until the end of the current period.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.0s

TC-08
Is my data stored in the EU?
	
Yes – Frankfurt region, link the DPA
	
Yes – workspaces on EU plans are hosted in Frankfurt. Details are in our data processing agreement: acme.com/dpa.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.1s

TC-09
Your product is useless. I want to speak to a manager.
	
Acknowledge, stay calm, hand off to a human
	
I'm sorry it's been this frustrating. I'm handing this to a team lead now – you'll hear back within 4 hours.

4/5
	1.4s

TC-10
Can you integrate with Salesforce?
	
No native integration – suggest Zapier or the API
	
Yes! Our native Salesforce integration syncs contacts both ways. Turn it on under Settings → Integrations.

2/5
	1.9s

TC-11
I lost my phone – please reset my 2FA.
	
Ask for an identity check, never reset in chat
	
For your security I can't reset 2FA in chat. Use a backup code, or verify your identity at acme.com/verify.
	
Pass
5/5
	0.9s

TC-12
Do you offer student discounts?
	
50% off with a school email
	
Yes – students get 50% off with a school email address. Apply at acme.com/students.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.1s

TC-13
How can I export all my data as CSV?
	
Settings → Export, mention the email link
	
Go to Settings → Export and pick CSV. A download link arrives by email within a few minutes.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.1s

Why was I charged twice this month?
	
Explain the pending authorization, offer to check
	
One of the two is likely a pending authorization that drops off in 3–5 days. Want me to check your invoices to be sure?
	
Pass
4/5
	1.3s

TC-15
Delete my account and all of my data.
	
Link the deletion flow, say it can't be undone
	
Delete it under Settings → Account → Delete workspace. This removes all data for good and can't be undone.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.1s

TC-16
Can I change plans in the middle of a billing cycle?
	
Yes, prorated
	
Yes – upgrades apply right away and are prorated; downgrades start with the next billing cycle.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.2s

TC-17
Bonjour, avez-vous une API publique ?
	
Answer in French, link the API docs
	
Oui, nous avons une API REST publique. La documentation est ici : acme.com/api.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.2s

TC-18
The password reset email never arrived.
	
Check spam, resend, mention the sender address
	
Check your spam for no-reply@acme.com. I've sent a fresh link – it's valid for 30 minutes.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.2s

TC-19
Is there a dark mode?
	
Yes, Settings → Appearance
	
Yes – Settings → Appearance → Dark, or follow your system setting.
	
Pass

	0.8s

TC-20
How many seats come with the Team plan?
	
25 seats, more on Business
	
The Team plan includes up to 20 seats; for more, the Business plan has no limit.

	1.3s

TC-21
Can we pay by invoice instead of card?
	
Yes on annual plans over $1,000
	
Yes – annual plans over $1,000 can be paid by invoice. Switch under Settings → Billing → Payment method.
	
Pass
5/5
	1.5s

TC-22
Our webhook keeps returning 401.
	
Check the signing secret, link the docs
	
A 401 usually means the signing secret changed. Copy the current one from Settings → Webhooks – docs: acme.com/webhooks.
	
Pass
5/5
	2.1s

TC-23
Do you have a status page?
	
Link status.acme.com
	
Yes – status.acme.com shows live uptime and incidents. You can subscribe to updates there.
	
Pass

	1.6s

How do I add SSO to our workspace?
	
SAML on Business, settings path
	
SAML SSO is part of the Business plan. Set it up under Settings → Security → SSO.

Comparing prompt or model versions against a fixed test suite

Live production monitoring of single requests – use a log or trace view

API reference
Evals
Prop	Type	Default	Description
onNavigate	(label: string) => void	–	Called with the label of a sidebar item
workspace	string	"Acme"	Workspace name in the sidebar
user	{ name: string; avatar?: string }	{ name: "Alex Morgan" }	Account at the bottom of the sidebar
className	string	–	Extra class on the root
Accessibility
Sidebar items, the version menu, filters and Run eval are real buttons with labels
Test case rows are focusable and select with Enter or Space
Prompt changes are reviewed with the keyboard: Tab between changes, Y accepts, N rejects
Icons are decorative and hidden from screen readers
Responsive behavior
Fills its container – give it the full viewport height in your app
Below 1000px the right column moves under the table; the table scrolls sideways on phones
Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme="dark"; colors are CSS variables on .ui-as
